faq.q: What is the Cekat.AI marketing solution?
faq.a: Segmented WhatsApp broadcasts, AI handling of ad leads, an ads performance dashboard, and conversion signals sent to ad platforms through the Conversion API, all in one platform.

faq.q: Are WhatsApp broadcasts safe from bans?
faq.a: Broadcasts go through the official WhatsApp Business API with Meta-approved templates, the channel built for business messaging, not unofficial blast tools that gamble your number.
Contact labels, conversation history, pipeline stage, ad source, and custom attributes you define. Segments can be saved and reused for the next campaign.

faq.q: What is the Conversion API and why does it matter?
faq.a: A way to send conversion events server-to-server to ad platforms. Deals closed in chat are invisible to browser pixels, so without CAPI your ad algorithms learn from incomplete data.
Meta and TikTok. All three receive the same real conversion signals, so optimization on each platform stands on accurate data.

faq.q: Can we see ROAS per campaign?
faq.a: Yes. Every contact carries its campaign source through to the order, so revenue per campaign reads on the dashboard and budget can shift to what is proven to earn.

faq.q: Are ad leads handled by AI immediately?
faq.a: Yes. Leads from Click-to-WhatsApp Ads get an AI greeting in the first second, their questions answered, and qualification done, then a handover to sales once they are ready.

faq.q: Can broadcasts be scheduled to send later?
faq.a: Yes. Build the campaign, pick the segment, then schedule it for the hour most likely to be read. Delivery results appear on the same dashboard once it has run.
